# pvecli node firewall

Manage the firewall of a node.

## status

Show whether the firewall is enforced here, and why not.

```text
pvecli node firewall status [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## enable

Turn the firewall of a node on. Checks the API stays reachable.

```text
pvecli node firewall enable [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## disable

Turn the firewall of a node off.

```text
pvecli node firewall disable [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## set

Change firewall options: policies, log levels, filters.

```text
pvecli node firewall set [TARGET] [SETTINGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |
| `SETTINGS` | KEY=VALUE pairs, as `options` names them. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--clear VALUE` | Options back to their default, comma separated. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Go on even if the API would be closed to this machine. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## options

Show the firewall options, with the defaults Proxmox applies.

```text
pvecli node firewall options [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## rule

Firewall rules of a node

```text
pvecli node firewall rule
```

## log

Show the last lines of the firewall log.

```text
pvecli node firewall log [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Node name. |

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--since N` |  | Only lines after this UNIX time. |
| `-l`, `--limit N` | `50` | Number of lines. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` |  | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
